# Originality Policy

Contributors should submit an Idea only if they sincerely believe the core idea is their own and has not already been publicly disclosed in the academic literature.

The repository does not certify worldwide absolute novelty, patentability, peer-reviewed validity, or the absence of prior work a contributor did not find.

Plagiarism, knowingly false originality claims, fabricated citations, and fabricated research results presented as real are not permitted.
